sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hol*? asks where someone or something is. The location phrase normally comes before van in a simple location sentence.

items.english: The book is on the table.

sections.content: A good way to lock in this word order: build the sentence backward from van. Start with van at the end, then ask ‘where?’ and slot that phrase just before it — az asztalon van, a szobában van, itt van. The verb becomes your anchor point instead of an afterthought.
